blinding_guess.why: The package uses the un-namespaced <property> and <insert_block> tags, invokes xacro.py, and defines its own pi property instead of the xacro:-prefixed forms or the xacro command also listed in the packet; whether the jade xacro rejects or only tolerates these forms cannot be judged from the snapshot alone. package.xml also declares no dependency on xacro although the launch files call it.

notes: All ten packet elements are consumed xacro-language or xacro-tool symbols; the package provides none of them, so declares and not_declared are empty. Scope: snapshot/ur_description only (package.xml, CMakeLists.txt, launch/{ur3,ur5,ur10}_upload.launch, launch/test.launch, 12 urdf/*.xacro files; meshes and model.pdf not relevant). Usage details: <property> appears 33 times in ur5.urdf.xacro, 28 in ur3.urdf.xacro and 28 in ur10.urdf.xacro; <insert_block name="origin" /> at ur3.urdf.xacro:57, ur5.urdf.xacro:73, ur10.urdf.xacro:58 (inside macro cylinder_inertial with a *origin block parameter); <xacro:include> in all robot files and in ur3/ur5/ur10.urdf.xacro; <xacro:macro> defines cylinder_inertial, ur3_robot, ur5_robot, ur10_robot, ur_arm_gazebo, ur_arm_transmission; xmlns:xacro="http://www.ros.org/wiki/xacro" on the <robot> root of all 12 xacro files; xacro.py is invoked as $(find xacro)/xacro.py in lines 5-6 of each *_upload.launch. The symbol pi is defined locally as <property name="pi" value="3.14159265" /> (ur3.urdf.xacro:11, ur5.urdf.xacro:7, ur10.urdf.xacro:12) and used in ${...} expressions throughout, including ur10_joint_limited_robot.urdf.xacro:13-18 and the ur10_robot macro's default parameters (ur10.urdf.xacro:66-72, written with := defaults). Not referenced anywhere in ur_description: api:<xacro:insert_block>, api:<xacro:property>, and api:xacro as a command (the launch files resolve the xacro package path with $(find xacro) but run xacro.py, not xacro); these are consumed-side elements, so they appear in no list. Other xacro constructs used but not in the packet: <xacro:if>/<xacro:unless> (12 occurrences combined in each of ur3/ur5/ur10.urdf.xacro) and macro invocations such as <xacro:ur5_robot .../>. package.xml (line 20) has only run_depend urdf; no build or run dependency on xacro. Ports: ROS 1, so QoS is null; msg_type, frame, units and definition_id are null because these are XML-preprocessing constructs, not message-carrying ports. exclusive is empty: ur.transmission.xacro declares <hardwareInterface>PositionJointInterface</hardwareInterface> for six joints (lines 9, 19, 29, 39, 49, 59), which exposes a command interface to ros_control rather than claiming one. The launch files also set param robot_description (not a packet element).
